Meet the Director

Coach Brian Fruscio

Coach Brian Fruscio is the Varsity Head Coach at Canterbury School and the Director & Founder of Straight Shooters C.V.C. Inc. With over 36 years running basketball camps, he is one of the most decorated and experienced coaches in New England.

Founded in 2011, Straight Shooters is built on Core Values ‚Äî Integrity, Honesty, Leadership, Sportsmanship & Teamwork ‚Äî both on and off the court. Canterbury teams have been consistently ranked in NESPSAC under his leadership.
